positioning.statement_vi: Thiết kế lộ trình học cá nhân hóa, hỗ trợ công việc học thuật và thực hành nghiên cứu có cấu trúc.
positioning.statement_en: Personalized learning support, academic project guidance, and structured qualitative research.
positioning.reason: Show transferable skills (problem diagnosis, structured iteration, analysis, evidence review) rather than an inflated full-time teaching credential.

tutoring.fact: Gia sư môn Toán cao cấp 1:1 cho một người học mất gốc, đạt mục tiêu môn học đã đặt ra.
tutoring.subject: Toán cao cấp (Advanced Mathematics course)
tutoring.credentials: No teaching certificate or formal institutional appointment claimed.
tutoring.portfolio_language_vi: Gia sư môn Toán cao cấp theo hình thức 1:1, hỗ trợ một người học mất căn bản củng cố kiến thức và đạt mục tiêu môn học.
tutoring.portfolio_language_en: Tutored Advanced Mathematics one-on-one, helping a learner rebuild foundational understanding and achieve their course objective.

academic_support.fact: Có một số lần hỗ trợ tiểu luận và khóa luận.
academic_support.boundaries: No assumption of ghostwriting, authorship, proofreading service, thesis supervision or formally paid teaching; describe as academic support unless specific activities confirmed.
academic_support.public_language_vi: Hỗ trợ học thuật theo từng dự án cho một số bài tiểu luận và khóa luận.
academic_support.public_language_en: Provided project-based academic support across several essay and thesis workflows.

essay_grades.public_display: HOLD—do not use 100%/80% as a success-rate chart without denominator, period and ownership clarification.

user_reported_evidence.user_reports_methodology: There is a personal method/process for tutoring and academic work. Exact steps were not supplied; do not represent a suggested process as the owner's verified operating method.

source_supported_research.source: Connected private Google Drive authored thesis working document; title and method read 2026-11-08
source_supported_research.title_vi: Đánh giá nội dung thị giác quảng bá sự kiện có sự tham gia của AI tạo sinh: So sánh giữa nhóm phía sản xuất và người tham dự tại Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh
source_supported_research.affiliation_as_in_draft: University-level graduation thesis; author identified in document
methods_from_draft: Comparative analysis of production-side and attendee interpretations
source_supported_research.published_excerpt_policy: Only high-level topic and method description; never expose participant transcripts, student IDs, instructor details, raw respondent data, or private Drive URLs.
source_supported_research.strong_story: Research into how creators and audiences assess AI-assisted event promotion visuals, combining the owner's event production knowledge with audience-oriented qualitative inquiry.
source_supported_research.candidate_showcase_mode: One editorial research case with question → study design → evidence organization → interpretation → limits; no invented findings or unverified data claims.

visual_presentation.page_role: Secondary cross-disciplinary proof point nested in SHOWTIME's Archive or About / Ways of Thinking; visually complement Event + AI.
structure: A single research showcase using a methodological diagram, safe graphic example and concise story (not raw data)
One compact 1:1 mathematics learning vignette: starting challenge → personalized support → user-reported goal achieved
Short academic support note; avoid presenting clients' work as owner's authorship
Optional small GPA fact after scale is confirmed
recommended_interactions: Explore how the same example visual may invite different evaluations; labeled as a conceptual illustration, not thesis experimental result
Expand a process card to show research choices and evidence discipline
Avoid pretend testimonials or faux numeric performance dashboards

restrictions: Selective self-presentation is fine, but no invented certifications, student roster, teacher employment, participant success rates, academic distinctions, grades or completed thesis results.
Do not claim 100% student score improvement; 100%/80% described by user refers to essays but denominator and assignment owner are unspecified.
Respect academic integrity and privacy; avoid implying ghostwriting other students' submitted work.
Self-authored thesis is evidence of research process, not of external acceptance or publication.
Do not publish sensitive Drive document URLs or excerpts; no respondent-level material.
next_action: No user input required to stage the supporting section. A future prepublication copy review can resolve GPA scale, exact tutoring method, and whether to display essay grade metrics.
